subject: Preflight call coordination and fallback owners — Starlake Analytics
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlakeanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@starlakeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: final preflight call before production cutover

Hi Vivek,

We just wrapped the internal readiness review and procurement asked that we have one final joint preflight with your team to confirm cutover steps, fallback owners, and the DocuSign timeline. Can we schedule a 60-minute slot next week? Prefer mornings (PT) for our engineers.

Attendees we need: our SRE + procurement + security. I can add Lena Ortiz (security) and procurement@starlakeanalytics.com.

Thanks — appreciate a few options so we can coordinate across teams.

Alex Turner
Head of Platform Engineering
Starlake Analytics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlakeanalytics.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@starlakeanalytics.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, procurement@starlakeanalytics.com, security@starlakeanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: final preflight call before production cutover

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up. Happy to run the preflight. To make scheduling easier, here are three proposed slots (all PT):

- Tue 2027-04-06 09:00–10:00 PT (best for our AE + SE)
- Tue 2027-04-06 11:00–12:00 PT (works if procurement needs an earlier sync)
- Wed 2027-04-07 08:30–09:30 PT (alternate if Tuesday conflicts)

Agenda we plan to cover (60m):
1) Cutover sequence & milestone owners (15m)
2) Fallback & rollback triggers + owners (15m)
3) Post-cutover validation & monitoring checks (15m)
4) Procurement/DocuSign timing and next steps (10m)

Please confirm which slot works and I’ll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and the preflight checklist attached. We’ll include Stephanie (SE) and Aditya (Solutions/Account) on the call. If procurement needs a different timezone window, tell us preferred times and we’ll adapt.

Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlakeanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@starlakeanalytics.com>, procurement@starlakeanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: final preflight call before production cutover

Vivek — thanks for the options. Procurement needs the window 10:30–11:30 PT on Tue 4/6 (they are blocked earlier). Our SRE prefers 08:30 PT but can be flexible. Can you do Tue 4/6 10:30–11:30 PT? If not, Wed 4/7 08:30–09:30 PT is acceptable.

Also, procurement would like to review the fallback roster ahead of time. Can you share a short table with primary and fallback owners per step?

Alex
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlakeanalytics.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, procurement@starlakeanalytics.com, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@starlakeanalytics.com>, security@starlakeanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: final preflight call before production cutover

Alex — Tue 4/6 10:30–11:30 PT works for us. I’ve tentatively held that slot and will send the official invite once I have confirmation from procurement. Attaching a short fallback roster and the preflight checklist for your review.

Quick owner summary (top-level):
- Cutover owner: Stephanie Nguyen (SE lead) — primary
- Fallback owner (immediate rollback): Aditya Rao (Solution Architect) — primary
- Escalation lead (exec contact): Vivek Kulkarni — fallback for commercial/decisioning
- Monitoring & Validation: Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — validation lead

We’ll walk through the detailed step-by-step in the meeting and mark exact playbook lines for each owner. Lena — if you or security want to add required evidence items to the checklist, flag them and we’ll incorporate.

Vivek

Attachments referenced: redwood_preflight_checklist_v2.pdf; fallback-roster.xlsx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlakeanalytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@starlakeanalytics.com>, procurement@starlakeanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: final preflight call before production cutover

Hi all — I’ll run the cutover sequence and the KV cache warm-up/traffic-shift steps during the call. A couple of technical notes ahead of time so the meeting can be efficient:

- We expect a short KV-cache rehydrate (approx 8–12 min) after the config push; Aditya will own the rollback script which detaches model traffic and restores previous config.
- For SSO and access tokens: please confirm your SSO admin will be reachable for a 10-min window during the cutover for any user provisioning edge cases.
- Lena/Security: I included a SOC2 evidence snippet in the shared Drive link (SOC2-evidence-link.txt) — if you need additional logs or retention policy statements, tell us and Aditya will pull them ahead of the call.

Fallback roster highlights (copied from attached):
- Step 1 (config push): primary=Stephanie Nguyen; fallback=Aditya Rao; escalation=Vivek Kulkarni
- Step 2 (traffic shift): primary=Aditya Rao; fallback=Marissa Cole; escalation=Vivek Kulkarni
- Step 3 (validation): primary=Marissa Cole; fallback=Stephanie Nguyen; escalation=Vivek Kulkarni

I’ll also bring the “quick rollback” script to the call and post a gist if we need to execute.

—Stephanie
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@starlakeanalytics.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@starlakeanalytics.com>, procurement@starlakeanalytics.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Preflight call confirmed — Tue 2027-04-06 10:30–11:30 PT (Zoom invite sent)

Alex/Lena/Procurement — confirmed for Tue 4/6 10:30–11:30 PT. I’ve sent the calendar invite with the Zoom link and attached the preflight checklist and fallback roster. Items included: preflight checklist, fallback-roster.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-link.txt.

Next steps before the call:
- Procurement: confirm decision representative on the invite (legal or procurement approver)
- Security: flag any evidence items missing from the SOC2 text file by EOD Mon 4/5
- Starlake SRE: confirm an admin contact for SSO provisioning during cutover

If anything changes, reply-all so we can re-open times. Looking forward to a smooth preflight.

Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
